alexander-locke-1908.title: Locke
alexander-locke-1908.creator: Samuel Alexander
alexander-locke-1908.description: Samuel Alexander's 1908 study of John Locke in the Philosophical Classics series.

arxiv-2011-14616.title: Automatic Mathematical Information Retrieval to Perform Translations up to Computer Algebra Systems
arxiv-2011-14616.creator: André Greiner-Petter
arxiv-2011-14616.description: Abstract In mathematics, L a T e X is the de facto standard to prepare documents, e.g., scientific publications. While some formulae are still developed using pen and paper, more complicated mathematical expressions used more and more often with computer algebra systems. Mathematical expressions are often manually transcribed to computer algebra systems.

arxiv-2307-06060.title: Interpreting deep embeddings for disease progression clustering
arxiv-2307-06060.creator: Anna Munoz-Farre, Antonios Poulakakis-Daktylidis, Dilini Mahesha Kothalawala, Andrea Rodriguez-Martinez
arxiv-2307-06060.description: Abstract We propose a novel approach for interpreting deep embeddings in the context of patient clustering. We evaluate our approach on a dataset of participants with type 2 diabetes from the UK Biobank, and demonstrate clinically meaningful insights into disease progression patterns.

arxiv-2307-07232.title: Envelopes of straight line families in the plane
arxiv-2307-07232.creator: Takashi Nishimura
arxiv-2307-07232.description: Abstract . There is a widespread method to represent the envelope when a given hyperplane family creates an envelope. However, one sometimes encounters cases when the widespread method fails to represent the desired envelope precisely, and is confused. At the same time, one wants to find a correct method to draw the envelope precisely.

arxiv-2309-01760.title: Galactic Pure Lovelock Blackholes: Geometry, stability, and Hawking temperature
arxiv-2309-01760.creator: Chiranjeeb Singha, Shauvik Biswas
arxiv-2309-01760.description: Abstract In this article, we will first-time model galactic black holes in pure Lovelock gravity. Even though working with higher spacetime dimensions, we assume (implicitly) the Hernquist-type mass profile for the galaxy in such a way that the horizon structure of a pure LoveLock black hole remains intact.

arxiv-2309-15523.title: Improving Facade Parsing with Vision Transformers and Line Integration
arxiv-2309-15523.creator: Bowen Wang, Jiaxin Zhang, Ran Zhang, Yunqin Li, Liangzhi Li, Yuta Nakashima
arxiv-2309-15523.description: Abstract Facade parsing stands as a pivotal computer vision task with far-reaching applications in areas like architecture, urban planning, and energy efficiency. Despite the recent success of deep learning-based methods in yielding impressive results on certain open-source datasets, their viability for real-world applications remains uncertain. Real-world scenarios are considerably more intricate, demanding greater computational efficiency.

arxiv-2310-10311.title: Dynamics-augmented cluster-based network model
arxiv-2310-10311.creator: Chang Hou 1, Nan Deng 1, Bernd R. Noack 1,2
arxiv-2310-10311.description: Abstract In this study, we propose a novel data-driven reduced-order model for complex dynamics, including nonlinear, multi-attractor, multi-frequency, and multiscale behaviours. The starting point is a fully automatable cluster-based network model (CNM) (Li et al. J. Fluid Mech. vol. 906, 2021, A21) which kinematically coarse-grains the state with clusters and dynamically predicts the transitions in a network model.

arxiv-2402-04828.title: What drives the European carbon market? Macroeconomic factors and forecasts Thanks: The authors gratefully acknowledge the participants at the 4th IWEEE in Bolzano for their useful feedback. Luca Rossini acknowledges financial support from the Italian Ministry MIUR under the PRIN-PNRR project Mappin
arxiv-2402-04828.creator: Andrea Bastianin, Elisabetta Mirto, Yan Qin, Luca Rossini
arxiv-2402-04828.description: Abstract Abstract: Putting a price on carbon – with taxes or developing carbon markets – is a widely used policy measure to achieve the target of net-zero emissions by 2050. This paper tackles the issue of producing point, direction-of-change, and density forecasts for the monthly real price of carbon within the EU Emissions Trading Scheme (EU ETS).

arxiv-2409-12954.title: GStex: Per-Primitive Texturing of 2D Gaussian Splatting for Decoupled Appearance and Geometry Modeling
arxiv-2409-12954.creator: Victor Rong Jingxiang Chen Sherwin Bahmani Kiriakos N. Kutulakos David B. Lindell
arxiv-2409-12954.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Victor Rong Jingxiang Chen Sherwin Bahmani Kiriakos N. Kutulakos David B. Lindell. Gaussian splatting has demonstrated excellent performance for view synthesis and scene reconstruction. The representation achieves photorealistic quality by optimizing the position, scale, color, and opacity of thousands to millions of 2D or 3D Gaussian primitives within a scene.

arxiv-2410-04238.title: Towards the Best Solution for Complex System Reliability: Can Statistics Outperform Machine Learning? Thanks: Corresponding author: rraya@ugr.es
arxiv-2410-04238.creator: María Luz Gámiz
arxiv-2410-04238.description: Abstract Studying the reliability of complex systems using machine learning techniques involves facing a series of technical and practical challenges, ranging from the intrinsic nature of the system and data to the difficulties in modeling and effectively deploying models in real-world scenarios.

arxiv-2504-11876.title: Generic regularity in time for solutions of the Stefan problem in 4+1 dimensions
arxiv-2504-11876.creator: Giacomo Colombo
arxiv-2504-11876.description: Abstract . We show that the free boundary of a solution of the Stefan problem in ℝ 4 + 1 \mathbb{R}^{4+1} is a 3 3 -dimensional manifold of class C ∞ C^{\infty} in \R 4 \R^{4} for almost every time.

arxiv-2601-18828.title: IPBC: An Interactive Projection-Based Framework for Human-in-the-Loop Semi-Supervised Clustering of High-Dimensional Data
arxiv-2601-18828.creator: Mohammad Zare
arxiv-2601-18828.description: Abstract High-dimensional datasets are increasingly common across scientific and industrial domains, yet they remain difficult to cluster effectively due to the diminishing usefulness of distance metrics and the tendency of clusters to collapse or overlap when projected into lower dimensions.

pmc-10548744.title: Cognitive decrements in 1991 Gulf War veterans: associations with Gulf War illness and neurotoxicant exposures in the Boston Biorepository, Recruitment, and Integrative Network (BBRAIN) cohorts
pmc-10548744.creator: D. Keating, M. Krengel, J. Dugas, R. Toomey, L. Chao, L. Steele, Lloyd P. Janulewicz, T. Heeren, E. Quinn, N. Klimas, K. Sullivan
pmc-10548744.description: BackgroundDuring deployment, veterans of the 1991 Gulf War (GW) were exposed to multiple war-related toxicants. Roughly a third of these veterans continue to exhibit neurotoxicant induced symptoms of Gulf War Illness (GWI), a multi-faceted condition that includes fatigue, pain and cognitive decrements.

pmc-11447530.title: Genome wide clustering on integrated chromatin states and Micro-C contacts reveals chromatin interaction signatures
pmc-11447530.creator: Corinne E Sexton, Sylvia Victor Paul, Dylan Barth, Mira V Han
pmc-11447530.description: We can now analyze 3D physical interactions of chromatin regions with chromatin conformation capture technologies, in addition to the 1D chromatin state annotations, but methods to integrate this information are lacking. We propose a method to integrate the chromatin state of interacting regions into a vector representation through the contact-weighted sum of chromatin states.

pmc-11477339.title: Peroxymonosulfate Activation by Fe@N Co-Doped Biochar for the Degradation of Sulfamethoxazole: The Key Role of Pyrrolic N
pmc-11477339.creator: Tong Liu, Chenxuan Li, Xing Chen, Yihan Chen, Kangping Cui, Dejin Wang, Qiang Wei, Haiyang Gao
pmc-11477339.description: In this study, Fe, N co-doped biochar (Fe@N co-doped BC) was synthesized by the carbonization–pyrolysis method and used as a carbocatalyst to activate peroxymonosulfate (PMS) for sulfamethoxazole (SMX) removal. In the Fe@N co-doped BC/PMS system, the degradation efficiency of SMX (10.0 mg·L−1) was 90.2% within 40 min under optimal conditions.

pmc-11517558.title: Working conditions in OOH-PC centres in Romania: an interview study with healthcare professionals
pmc-11517558.creator: S Ciotlăuș, I M Ungureanu, F Oprescu
pmc-11517558.description: Considering the amplifying primary care workforce shortage, the existing knowledge gaps in out-of-hours primary care delivery (OOH-PC) in Romania, as well as the extreme county-to-county variation in the number of functioning OOH-PC centers across the country, from 0 to 32, we set out to document health workers’ perspectives on existing challenges in after hours primary care.

pmc-11544998.title: Bioactive Adrenomedullin in Dogs with Sepsis and Septic Shock: A Prospective, Case-Control Study
pmc-11544998.creator: Eirini Chrysovergi, Carmel T Mooney, Robert E Shiel, Evangelia M Stavroulaki, Kevin Murtagh, Juan Carlos Illera del Portal
pmc-11544998.description: Simple SummarySepsis and septic shock are life-threatening conditions affecting both humans and dogs. Early detection and treatment are crucial for improving outcomes, but timely diagnosis remains challenging. Adrenomedullin (ADM), a naturally occurring hormone with a potent vasodilatory effect, has emerged as a potential biomarker to aid in the diagnosis and prognostication of sepsis and septic shock in humans.

pmc-11640609.title: Landscape of Biomarkers and Pathologic Response in Rectal Cancer: Where We Stand?
pmc-11640609.creator: Abrahams Ocanto, Macarena Teja, Francesco Amorelli, Felipe Couñago, Ariel Gomez Palacios, Diego Alcaraz, Ramón Cantero
pmc-11640609.description: Simple SummaryThis manuscript aims to provide a comprehensive update on biomarkers in rectal cancer, focusing on both established and emerging markers. It highlights the most significant advancements in recent years, particularly those that align with the evolution of neoadjuvant treatment in this disease.

pmc-11678581.title: LncRNA-MSTRG.19083.1 Targets NTRK2 as a miR-429-y Sponge to Regulate Circadian Rhythm via the cAMP Pathway in Yak Testis and Cryptorchidism
pmc-11678581.creator: Tianan Li, Qiu Yan, Jinghong Nan, Xue Huang, Ruiqing Wang, Yong Zhang, Xingxu Zhao, Qi Wang, Jan Tesarik
pmc-11678581.description: Long noncoding RNAs (LncRNAs) play essential roles in numerous biological processes in mammals, such as reproductive physiology and endocrinology. Cryptorchidism is a common male reproductive disease. Circadian rhythms are actively expressed in the reproductive system. In this study, a total of 191 LncRNAs were obtained from yak testes and cryptorchids.

pmc-12455981.title: Permissiveness of different TMEM154 genotype cell lines to different SRLV genotypes/subtypes
pmc-12455981.creator: Barbara Colitti, Daniele Avanzato, Riccardo Moretti, Irati Moncayola, Margherita Profiti, Stefania Chessa, Paola Sacchi, Sergio Rosati, Ramses Reina
pmc-12455981.description: Small ruminant lentiviruses (SRLVs) are a heterogeneous group of viruses that infect goats and sheep worldwide, for which no cures or effective vaccines are available. Control measures have been based on early diagnosis and accurate management with limited success due to re-emergence of seropositivity and disease in controlled flocks.

pmc-12555281.title: 10.Q. Scientific session: Loneliness as a public health challenge: new measures, trends, and protective factors
pmc-12555281.creator: Organised by: Right to Belong consortium, University of Turku (Finland), Chair persons: Niina Junttila (Finland)
pmc-12555281.description: Rationale and ObjectivesLoneliness has emerged as a global public health concern with broad implications for mental and physical health across populations. Yet existing tools and frameworks tend to individualize what is often a structurally embedded and socially patterned experience. This scientific session aims to: 1. Reframe loneliness as both individual and collective phenomenon across the lifespan; 2.

pmc-12615103.title: Upper Gastrointestinal Bleeding Secondary to Gastric Invasion by Diffuse Large B-cell Lymphoma
pmc-12615103.creator: Helen Paglia, Marco Noriega, Kinnari R Kher
pmc-12615103.description: Diffuse large B-cell lymphoma (DLBCL) is the most common non-Hodgkin lymphoma subtype. We present a case of an 80-year-old male with upper gastrointestinal bleeding (UGIB), ultimately diagnosed with DLBCL involving the liver, gallbladder, inferior vena cava, and stomach, leading to a large gastric ulcer. Despite initial suspicion of alcohol-related UGIB, imaging revealed multiple masses with extranodal lymphoma involvement.

pmc-13326345.title: Correction: Nanovaccines with ferroptosis, necroptosis and STING-activation for synergistic immunotherapy
pmc-13326345.creator: Jia-Rui Du, Mu-Le Tu, Yong-Xu Xia, Yuan-Qiang Lin, Rui Yang, Chang Weng, Yi Liu, Hao Zhang, Hui Wang, Wen-Jie Feng, Deng-Ke Teng

The details are given below: In page 3 - “Fe” should be corrected to “Fe2+”.

pmc-13416606.title: Optimizing the Reliability of Underground Utility Tunnel Localization via Multi-Source Fusion and DVAE-CNN
pmc-13416606.creator: Shaolong Chang, Zhiguo Zhang, Xueliang Gug, Tong Zhai, Shanming Liu, Yang Zhao, Tian Guo
pmc-13416606.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). This paper proposes a reliability-optimized localization method for underground utility tunnels based on multi-source fusion and a denoising variational autoencoder model. The method acquires a multi-sensor localization dataset aligned with a unified time reference. By employing a convolutional neural network-assisted denoising variational autoencoder (DVAE-CNN), it regulates localization outcomes through three key aspects: a multi-source heterogeneous data quality assessment model, a formulation of the target state transition equation, and an environmental prior-information-aided weight update strategy.

pmc-13554214.title: Benchmarking deep learning models for laryngeal cancer staging using the LaryngealCT dataset
pmc-13554214.creator: Nivea Roy, Son N. Tran, Atul Sajjanhar, K. Devaraja, Prakashini Koteshwara, Yong Xiang, Divya Rao

pmc-13621268.title: New-onset lupus nephritis and neuropsychiatric lupus following COVID-19 vaccination: A case report
pmc-13621268.creator: Paulo Simão, Micael Pompermayer, Joana Coutinho, Ernesto Rocha
pmc-13621268.description: Although COVID-19 mRNA vaccines have demonstrated excellent safety profiles, rare autoimmune complications – including new-onset systemic lupus erythematosus (SLE) and lupus nephritis (LN) – have been reported. We describe a case of new-onset class IV LN with neuropsychiatric lupus (NPSLE) occurring shortly after COVID-19 vaccination in a previously healthy adult.

uslaw-usc-t37-s320.creator: United States Congress

Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. (a) Eligible Career Enlisted Flyer Defined.— In this section, the term “eligible career enlisted flyer” means an enlisted member of the armed forces who— (1) is entitled to basic.
